title: helianthemum marifolium subsp. dichroum
intro: Helianthemum marifolium subsp. dichroum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-stress properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
